Frank, saw Reggora raised $18M, acquired Appreeze, and is rolling out a 24-hour appraisal product.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more lender accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Reggora off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Frank, quick follow-up for Reggora.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and a new product like 24-hour appraisals widens the addressable list further. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Reggora needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Frank, last bit of proof for Reggora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Reggora reply rate likely compares to other funded mortgage-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
